title: Phone Slip: Platte Valley 8 News, Live at 16:00

fields.message: Going live from Ellery Ridge at 16:00. Their lower-third says 'Viewers report 988 crisis line not answering.' To change it they want calls since noon + current wait time. Producer STILL wants one caller's story (says anon is OK). 'No comment = we run it as is.' He also says @HuskerMomOf3 posted at 15:16 'THE LINE IS DOWN, call 911 instead' and it has 2,300 reposts. @CornhuskerKelli replied 'confirmed, my cousin works there.'

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Watch whether the DCO checks the wording against safe messaging before the COM posts one factual correction: 988 is open by call, text and chat, marked EXERCISE, waits are longer and backup centers are helping. The COM should not argue in the replies. The ED should give the reporter a short reviewed statement before 16:00 without raw counts, turn down any caller story plainly and offer the safe messaging note.
